title: Drone flights over Nevada nuclear testing range
place_text: Nevada nuclear testing range, north of Las Vegas

tellings.quote: earlier there were several mystery drone flights over our nuclear testing range in Nevada just north of Las Vegas

plain: Several mystery drones flew over the US nuclear testing range in Nevada, just north of Las Vegas. Michels mentions it himself in a 2024 episode with Robert Hastings, a researcher of UFO reports at nuclear sites. He raises it as a sign that something may be watching American nuclear sites.
